page0.text:
Shinji comes first.
If Saber defeated Rider, my job is to catch Shinji and make him quit being a Master!
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page0:1

page1.text:
"Hah...ha...haaah!"
The sharp sound of footsteps echoed in the darkness.
Shinji is fleeing down the dark staircase.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page1:1

page2.text: "Damn...! What the hell is with that woman!? How can something so freaking crazy happen!? Rider's Noble Phantasm is supposed to be the strongest, so how the hell did she lose!? Why does a stupid Saber have a Noble Phantasm like that!? It's not fair. It's not fair! IT'S NOT FAIR!!!"
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page2:1

page3.text:
He rolls down the stairs, crashes into a wall, and then scampers on the ground.
Shinji is heading down, down, down.
The image of the light severing Rider is ingrained into his mind, never leaving.
It's like he says. That Noble Phantasm was unbelievable.
That sacred sword may look godly to allies, but to an opponent it must be truly, horribly demonic.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page3:1

page4.text:
"Fu...fuah...aaah!!!"
So Shinji runs, even in pitch darkness.
That light will find him if he stops.
And if he turns around, it'll burn him to nothing, just like Rider.
He can't afford to stop.
More than the loss of his Servant, more than the loss of his Command Spells and the end to his time as a Master...Shinji fears for his life.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page4:1

page5.text:
"Hah...! Damn...damndamndamndamn!!!
What was that crap about her Noble Phantasm being invincible!? That woman was all talk! How dare she trick me! She got into this mess because she was just too arrogant... That idiot!"
But she followed his orders, just as he gave them to her.
He told her not to make it quick.
Rider had suggested destroying their enemies with a single blow from her Noble Phantasm, but Shinji ignored her and instead backed Saber into a corner.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page5:1

page6.text:
"Haaa...ah...gahhh!!!"
He's fallen again.
He should be near to escaping the darkness, but he's run into a wall of some kind.
"What!? Who the hell put a wall here!?"
He punches it to vent his anger.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page6:1

page7.text:
"...Huh?"
Something sounds off.
Shinji looks again at what he thought was a wall, then looks at his own arm, which is bent backward in a near circle...
...
He's too afraid even to scream.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page7:1

page8.text: "You're not playing fair, you little Makiri maggot. There's no escape for losers like you."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page8:1

page9.text:
Playful laughter fills the stairwell.
A silver-haired girl emerges from the oppressive darkness.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page9:1

page10.text:
"Ma..."
He recognizes her.
In the brief instant Shinji realizes who he is seeing, he dies.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page10:1

page11.text:
I run through the darkened stairwell.
It may be too dark to see, but I can still pursue Shinji.
There's nothing else around to make noise at this point.
The sound of Shinji's footsteps echoes up the stairwell, so he's not hard to follow.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page11:1

page12.text:
"Huh? I don't hear his footsteps anymore..."
The change happens suddenly.
He was close. I could hear it, and he's still got a ways to go before he reaches the elevators.
I can't think of any reason for Shinji to stop here.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page12:1

page13.text:
"...Shinji?"
I move quietly, cautiously...
...and immediately find the reason his footsteps stopped.
I see where Shinji stopped running.
The corridor, which had been empty when I passed by on my way up, is now splattered with blood.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page13:1

page14.text:
...
I feel my senses buzz with numbness.
Before my mind even attempts to understand what's happened here, my body reacts instinctively.
I shouldn't be here.
Saber told me to listen to my senses, and they are screaming at me to head back to the roof if I want to live.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page14:1

page15.text:
"Sorry I'm late. Are you all right, Saber?"
I fight down my nausea and make my way to Saber.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page15:1

page16.text:
"Eh...?"
Saber is in bad shape.
Beads of sweat trickle down her brow, and her breath is shallow, labored. She looks like she's got a fever.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page16:1

page17.text:
"No way... Hey, Saber! What's going on!?"
I call out to Saber nervously, but she doesn't respond.
...She's out cold.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page17:1

page18.text:
"Sa...ber...?"
I touch her forehead.
"It's hot!"
I jerk my hand away.
I-it's unnaturally hot!
She's got to be running a fever of over forty degrees!
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page18:1

page19.text:
"Saber! Hey, pull yourself together!"
I call out to her, but her only response is shallow, anguished breathing.
"...Ngh!"
I don't know what the hell's going on.
I don't know what to do, but I can't just stand around.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page19:1

page20.text:
"I'm going to take you home! I'll deal with any complaints later!"
I lift Saber up.
She's so light.
I knew that, of course...but now she seems even lighter.
No, more than that, she's...
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page20:1

page21.text:
"She's warm. That means she's still alive."
Saber is still the person I've known all this time.
I'm pissed with myself for even hesitating.
Damn! What's it matter if she's a hero?
No matter who Saber is, she's here, and she's still warm.
How much of an idiot was I for putting up this wall between us before!?
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page21:1

page22.text:
"We're going home quick. Just hold still, Saber!"
I start running, Saber in my arms.
There's no sense of triumph from this victory.
All I feel is Saber in my arms, barely breathing.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-05:page22:1
